name: Forward-Backward Voxel Transformation
definition: A two-pass algorithm to transform a voxel point cloud (source) to a new orientation and position (destination) without introducing holes. It combines a forward pass (projecting source points to destination space) with an inverse pass (sampling source space for every destination voxel) to ensure full coverage.
summary: Forward-Backward Voxel Transformation is a two-pass algorithm that prevents visual holes in rotated voxel clouds by combining forward projection with inverse sampling to ensure full coverage.
